subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. What will be the sum of the expected numbers on the face opposite to the one showing '1'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7726e7b4d89a22a67ad198f3b973b71359aa529bb5fc1d82d314edd58bae883.png]
solution:
For find the sum of the expected numbers on the face opposite to the one showing '1',

Now, number '5' and '1' is given in Dice 1 and Dice 2, 

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf4af36c42524c48a90756f0a618556e110cd937ac8d55f84358f72b1a3115de.png] 

→ 5 and 1 is the common surface and 3 and 4 is the adjacent surface.

So, the remaining '6' or '2' will be the opposite face of '1'.

and sum of the expected numbers on the face opposite to the one showing '1' is (6 + 2) = 8

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
